title: "The deadline moved" without a new date stores nothing and keeps the old date until the new one is given

turns.user: The Orion API migration is due on March 14.

agent_captures.quote: The Orion API migration is due on March 14

turns.agent_reply: Noted: the Orion API migration is due on March 14. I'll track the remaining endpoints against it.

turns.user: List the endpoints that still use the v1 serializer.
turns.agent_reply: Seven endpoints still use the v1 serializer: /orders, /orders/{id}, /refunds, /customers, /customers/{id}, /invoices and /webhooks. The rest already use v2.

turns.user: Heads up: the Orion migration deadline moved.
turns.agent_reply: Thanks for the heads-up. Do you know the new date? Until you tell me, I'll treat March 14 as unconfirmed.

turns.user: Not yet, I'll find out tomorrow.
turns.agent_reply: Ok. Tell me when you know and I'll update it.

turns.user: Update: the Orion migration is now due on April 4.

agent_captures.quote: the Orion migration is now due on April 4

turns.agent_reply: Updated: the Orion migration is now due on April 4. March 14 no longer applies.

turns.user: How many endpoints are left to move before the deadline?
turns.agent_reply: Seven endpoints still use the v1 serializer, and the deadline is April 4. Moving two a week gets us there with time to spare.
